annotations.title: Read how far the tourism figures go and how recent they are

description: Reads which tourism figures the service holds and how recent they are: the latest year, how many comuni are covered, the last import, what each metric means and the 2025 break in the series. Use it to check how current the figures are, what a metric means or why a comune has a gap; do not use it to read the figures themselves (use leggi_dati_comune instead) or to find a comune by name (use cerca_comune instead). With a 6-digit `cod_istat` it adds the years with figures and with capacity for that comune and whether it has a projection and why not; without one `per_comune` is null. `aggiornato_il` is the time of the last successful import, null if none is recorded, not of the last check for new files. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

cod_istat.description: Optional: 6-digit ISTAT code of one comune as a string, leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma), from cerca_comune, to add its own coverage; omit it for the summary of the whole country. An unknown code returns an error that says what to pass.

name: leggi_copertura_dati

aggiornato_il.description: UTC timestamp of the last successful import of the ISTAT tourism files (ISO 8601): when the figures were last loaded, not when they were last checked. Null if no import is recorded.

cadenza.description: How the figures are kept up to date: when the service checks for new ISTAT files and what makes the figures change.

comuni_con_dati.description: How many comuni have movement figures in `ultimo_anno_annuale`; the ISTAT rows that group the small comuni of a province are not counted.

comuni_totali.description: Number of comuni, as counted by elenca_territori.

definizioni.description: What the metrics of classifica_territori mean, one entry per metric, with the same wording as its `filtri` parameter. Presenze are nights spent, not people.

discontinuita.description: The break in the series: the year ISTAT changed what its counts include.

anno.description: First year counted with the new scope.

spiegazione.description: What changed and which figures are no longer comparable.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Notes in English, null when there is nothing to say: no figures loaded yet, or the comune has no movement figures.

per_comune.description: The coverage of the one comune asked for with `cod_istat`; null when `cod_istat` was omitted.

anni_con_capacita.description: Years with a row of capacity figures (bed places and establishments), oldest first; an empty list when the comune has none.

anni_con_dati.description: Years with a row of movement figures (nights and arrivals), oldest first; an empty list when the comune has none.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

ha_previsioni.description: True when leggi_previsioni_comune has a projection of the total nights for this comune; null when projections are not public at the moment.

motivo.description: Why there is no projection, null when there is one: the `motivo` codes of leggi_previsioni_comune, or non_calcolata = none is stored for the comune, or non_pubbliche = projections are not public at the moment.

ultimo_anno_annuale.description: Latest year with yearly movement figures (the default `anno` of the other tools); null only when no figures are loaded.

ultimo_periodo_infrannuale.description: Latest period with sub-annual (monthly) nights, as YYYY-MM. Only this date is given: the monthly figures themselves are not served here. Null if there are none.

title: Read how far the tourism figures go and how recent they are
